records.jp: もう、それじゃだめ！<CR>素材がいいんだから、もったいないよ
records.en_original: Ugh, that's no good! You have great potential, but you're letting it go to waste.
records.en_auxiliary: Ugh, that's no good! You have great potential, but you're letting it go to waste.
records.en: Ugh, that's no good! You have great potential, but you're letting it go to waste.

records.jp: （あ、しほりがおしゃれのアドバイスしてるのかな。<CR>相手は――）
records.en_original: (Oh, sounds like Shihori is giving someone fashion advice. Who could it be...?)
records.en_auxiliary: (Oh, sounds like Shihori is giving someone fashion advice. Who could it be?)
records.en: (Oh, sounds like Shihori is giving someone fashion advice. Who could it be...?)

records.en_original: (Yuri!?)
records.en_auxiliary: (Yuri?!)
records.en: (Yuri!?)

records.jp: 化粧品にはアルキル基を含む合成物質やパラベンなど、<CR>有害な成分が含まれていることもあると聞く
records.en_original: I hear that cosmetics often contain harmful alkyls, parabens, and other compounds.
records.en_auxiliary: I hear that cosmetics often contain harmful alkyls, parabens, and other compounds.
records.en: I hear that cosmetics often contain harmful alkyls, parabens, and other compounds.

records.jp: 微量とはいえ、蓄積することで害をなすものもあるだろう。<CR>そもそも、研究に化粧は必要ない
records.en_original: While the quantities may be small, they can accumulate to harmful levels. Besides, research doesn't require makeup.
records.en_auxiliary: While the quantities may be small, they can accumulate to harmful levels. Besides, research doesn't require makeup.
records.en: While the quantities may be small, they can accumulate to harmful levels. Besides, research doesn't require makeup.

records.jp: ふ、二人とも、どうしたの？
records.en_original: S-So, what's going on here...?
records.en_auxiliary: S-so, what's going on here?
records.en: S-So, what's going on here...?

records.jp: あ、日菜子ちゃん……
records.en_original: Ah, Hinako...
records.en_auxiliary: Ah, Hinako.
records.en: Ah, Hinako-chan...

records.jp: 有理ちゃんにお肌の手入れをどうしてるのか聞いたら、<CR>何にもしてないっていうから、つい……
records.en_original: I was asking Yuri what she does to take care of her skin, and she said she does nothing, so I couldn't help myself...
records.en_auxiliary: I was asking Yuri what she does to take care of her skin, and she said she does nothing, so I couldn't help myself.
records.en: I was asking Yuri-chan what she does to take care of her skin, and she said she does nothing, so I couldn't help myself...

records.jp: （あはは……何だか、私も身に覚えがある……）
records.en_original: (Ahaha... I seem to recall the same thing happening to me...)
records.en_auxiliary: (Hah! I seem to recall the same thing happening to me.)
records.en: (Ahaha... I seem to recall the same thing happening to me...)

records.jp: 私は、なぜ女性がおしゃれというものをするのか聞きたかった<CR>だけなんだが、そこからなぜかこうなったというわけだ……
records.en_original: I simply wished to ask her why women have a desire to be fashionable, but our conversation went quickly astray...
records.en_auxiliary: I simply wished to ask her why women have a desire to be fashionable, but our conversation went quickly off track.
records.en: I simply wished to ask her why women have a desire to be fashionable, but our conversation went quickly astray...

records.jp: 女の子なら、身だしなみには気を遣わなきゃ。<CR>お肌だけじゃなくて、服や髪もそう
records.en_original: Girls need to keep their personal appearances in mind. Not just skin, but clothes and hair, too.
records.en_auxiliary: Girls need to keep their personal appearances in mind. Not just skin, but clothes and hair, too.
records.en: Girls need to keep their personal appearances in mind. Not just skin, but clothes and hair, too.

records.jp: 特に髪！　おしゃれで伸ばしてるわけじゃないなら<CR>一度切ってみた方がいいよ。その方が似合うから！
records.en_original: Especially hair! If you aren't growing it out for a particular style, you should cut it. You'd look good!
records.en_auxiliary: Especially hair! If you aren't growing it out for a particular style, you should cut it. You'd look good!
records.en: Especially hair! If you aren't growing it out for a particular style, you should cut it. You'd look good!

records.jp: 髪は切ってもまた伸びてくるだろう？<CR>切るのは最低限の回数で済むほうがいい
records.en_original: Even if you do cut it, hair just grows back. Keeping cutting to a bare minimum saves time.
records.en_auxiliary: Even if you do cut it, hair just grows back. Keeping cutting to a bare minimum saves time.
records.en: Even if you do cut it, hair just grows back. Keeping cutting to a bare minimum saves time.

records.jp: あはは……そこも合理性が優先なんだ……
records.en_original: Ahaha... Prioritizing efficiency, as usual...
records.en_auxiliary: Heh... Prioritizing efficiency, as usual.
records.en: Ahaha... Prioritizing efficiency, as usual...

records.jp: （……ん？　髪洗ったり乾かしたりするのにかかる時間を<CR>考えたら、切っちゃう方が合理的じゃないかな……？）
records.en_original: (...Or is she? If you consider the time spent washing and drying your hair, keeping it short is more efficient...)
records.en_auxiliary: (Or is she? If you consider the time spent washing and drying your hair, keeping it short is more efficient.)
records.en: (...Or is she? If you consider the time spent washing and drying your hair, keeping it short is more efficient...)

records.jp: （……いや、有理ならその辺りも適当にしてそうな気がする）
records.en_original: (...I take it back. I feel like Yuri doesn't spend much time on things like that.)
records.en_auxiliary: (I take it back. I feel like Yuri doesn't spend much time on things like that.)
records.en: (...I take it back. I feel like Yuri doesn't spend much time on things like that.)

records.jp: もう、全然聞いてくれないんだから……<CR>日菜子ちゃんはどう思う？
records.en_original: Ugh, you just don't listen. What do you think, Hinako?
records.en_auxiliary: Ugh, you just don't listen. What do you think, Hinako?
records.en: Ugh, you just don't listen. What do you think, Hinako-chan?

records.jp: え、私？　そうだなあ……
records.en_original: Huh, me? Let's see...
records.en_auxiliary: Huh, me? Let's see...
records.en: Huh, me? Let's see...

records.jp: 最初は面倒だと思うかもしれないけど……<CR>おしゃれを続けてみたら、その心理がわかるかも？
records.en_original: You might think it's a nuisance at first... But maybe if you try being stylish, you'll understand Shihori's mentality.
records.en_auxiliary: You might think it's a nuisance at first... But maybe if you try being stylish, you'll understand Shihori's mentality.
records.en: You might think it's a nuisance at first... But maybe if you try being stylish, you'll understand Shihori's mentality.

records.jp: 自分と違う感性の人の気持ちを知るのも大事でしょ？<CR>一度やってみてだめだと思ったら戻せばいいんだし
records.en_original: It's important to understand how different people feel, right? Try it! If you don't like it, you can go back to you.
records.en_auxiliary: It's important to understand how different people feel, right? Try it! If you don't like it, you can go back to you.
records.en: It's important to understand how different people feel, right? Try it! If you don't like it, you can go back to you.

records.jp: ああ、それは一理あるな……
records.en_original: I suppose that makes some sense...
records.en_auxiliary: I suppose that makes some sense.
records.en: I suppose that makes some sense...

records.jp: ふふ、じゃあ決まりね。じゃあ、まずはメイクから！
records.en_original: Hehe, then it's decided. Step one of our makeover is makeup!
records.en_auxiliary: Hehe, then it's decided. Step one of our makeover is makeup!
records.en: Hehe, then it's decided. Step one of our makeover is makeup!

records.jp: ま、待ってくれ、まだやるとは……
records.en_original: W-Wait, I never agreed to that...
records.en_auxiliary: W-wait, I never agreed to that!
records.en: W-Wait, I never agreed to that...

records.jp: ……有理、覚悟決めるしかないよ
records.en_original: ...Yuri, you should just brace yourself.
records.en_auxiliary: Yuri, you should just brace yourself.
records.en: ...Yuri, you should just brace yourself.

records.jp: 有理ちゃんにはどれがいいかなー、ふふふっ
records.en_original: Now, what would bring out your best qualities? Hehehe.
records.en_auxiliary: Now, what would bring out your best qualities? Hehehe!
records.en: I wonder which one would suit you best, Yuri-chan... Hehehe.

records.jp: ……………。<CR>他人のことなのに、ずいぶんと楽しそうにするんだな
records.en_original: ...This isn't about you, yet you seem to be having quite a bit of fun.
records.en_auxiliary: This isn't about you, yet you seem to be having quite a bit of fun.
records.en: ...This isn't about you, yet you seem to be having quite a bit of fun.

records.jp: もちろんだよ！<CR>みんなでキレイになれるんだもの、素敵なことでしょ？
records.en_original: Of course! We can all be pretty together! Isn't that a wonderful thing?
records.en_auxiliary: Of course! We can all be pretty together! Isn't that a wonderful thing?
records.en: Of course! We can all be pretty together! Isn't that a wonderful thing?

records.jp: キレイになるって、自分を磨くことだから……<CR>効果が出れば出るほど嬉しくなるしね
records.en_original: Being pretty means refining yourself... The better the results, the happier you get.
records.en_auxiliary: Being pretty means refining yourself. The better the results, the happier you get.
records.en: Being pretty means refining yourself... The better the results, the happier you get.

records.jp: みんながキレイになると私も嬉しいし、<CR>キレイになる喜びをみんなにも知ってほしいの！
records.en_original: I'd be so happy if everyone could be pretty. I want everyone to know how good it feels!
records.en_auxiliary: I'd be so happy if everyone could be pretty. I want everyone to know how good it feels!
records.en: I'd be so happy if everyone could be pretty. I want everyone to know how good it feels!

records.jp: なるほど……君はそういう考え方なのか
records.en_original: Interesting... So that's how you think.
records.en_auxiliary: Interesting. So that's how you think.
records.en: Interesting... So that's how you think.

records.jp: うん。有理ちゃんにも、おしゃれの良さが伝わった？
records.en_original: Yup. Do you understand how great fashion is now, Yuri?
records.en_auxiliary: Yup. Do you understand how great fashion is now, Yuri?
records.en: Yup. Do you understand how great fashion is now, Yuri-chan?

records.jp: ……ああ。その良さは認めよう
records.en_original: ...Yes. I think I do.
records.en_auxiliary: Yes. I think I do.
records.en: ...Yes. I think I do.

records.jp: 良かった！　じゃあこれからメイクして、服も探して、<CR>アクセサリーも、それから――
records.en_original: Good! Then let's put on makeup, then find some clothes and some accessories, and then...
records.en_auxiliary: Good! Then let's put on makeup, then find some clothes and some accessories, and then...
records.en: Good! Then let's put on makeup, then find some clothes and some accessories, and then...

records.jp: そ、そんなにあるのか！？
records.en_original: Th-There's that much to do!?
records.en_auxiliary: Th-there's that much to do?!
records.en: Th-There's that much to do!?

records.jp: ……うん、いっぱいあるよ。<CR>頑張ってね、有理……
records.en_original: ...Yeah, there's a lot. Good luck, Yuri...
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah, there's a lot. Good luck, Yuri.
records.en: ...Yeah, there's a lot. Good luck, Yuri...

records.jp: 社会に出たら身だしなみはきちんとしなきゃいけないし……<CR>今から練習しておくのもいいんじゃないかな
records.en_original: When you enter society, you need to keep up your appearance... It might be good to start practicing now.
records.en_auxiliary: When you enter society, you need to keep up your appearance. It might be good to start practicing now.
records.en: When you enter society, you need to keep up your appearance... It might be good to start practicing now.

records.jp: ふむ……面倒な風習があるものだな。<CR>不要なことでもしなくてはならないとは……
records.en_original: Hm... What a bothersome custom, to be forced to do such frivolous things...
records.en_auxiliary: Hm. What a bothersome custom to be forced to do such frivolous things.
records.en: Hm... What a bothersome custom, to be forced to do such frivolous things...

records.jp: 慣れてきたら、面倒だなんて思わなくなるよ。<CR>むしろ楽しくなってくるから！
records.en_original: You won't think it's bothersome once you're used to it. In fact, you start having fun with it!
records.en_auxiliary: You won't think it's bothersome once you're used to it. In fact, you might have some fun!
records.en: You won't think it's bothersome once you're used to it. In fact, you start having fun with it!

records.jp: 楽しく……か。面倒ごとでも楽しむ意気がなくては<CR>やっていられないということ――
records.en_original: Fun...? So, you force yourself to enjoy it, to put up with such an unnecessary nuisance--
records.en_auxiliary: Fun? So, you force yourself to enjoy it, to put up with such an unnecessary nuisance—
records.en: Fun...? So, you force yourself to enjoy it, to put up with such an unnecessary nuisance--

records.jp: もう、そういうことじゃないの！<CR>楽しくて面倒なんかじゃなくなるってことなの
records.en_original: Ugh, it's not like that! I'm saying it's fun, and it doesn't bother me at all!
records.en_auxiliary: Ugh, it's not like that! I'm saying it's fun, and it doesn't bother me at all!
records.en: Ugh, it's not like that! I'm saying it's fun, and it doesn't bother me at all!

records.jp: いつか有理ちゃんにも、キレイになることに<CR>意味があるんだってわかる日がくるよ
records.en_original: I'm sure the day will come when you understand the meaning of being pretty, Yuri.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm sure the day will come when you understand the joy of being pretty, Yuri.
records.en: I'm sure the day will come when you understand the meaning of being pretty, Yuri-chan.

records.jp: だから、それまでは騙されたと思って<CR>やってみてよ。ね？
records.en_original: So until then, just try it, even if you feel like you're being tricked. Okay?
records.en_auxiliary: So until then, just try it, even if you feel like you're being tricked. Okay?
records.en: So until then, just try it, even if you feel like you're being tricked. Okay?

records.jp: ……そうだな、やってみる前から<CR>あれこれ言っても仕方ない
records.en_original: ...I suppose I shouldn't complain about something before I actually attempt it.
records.en_auxiliary: I suppose I shouldn't complain about something before I actually try it.
records.en: ...I suppose I shouldn't complain about something before I actually attempt it.

records.jp: まずやってみるとしよう。<CR>すまないが、方法を教えてもらえないか？
records.en_original: Very well, I'll try it. Sorry, but would you mind teaching me the proper methods?
records.en_auxiliary: Very well, I'll do it. Sorry, but would you mind teaching me the proper methods?
records.en: Very well, I'll try it. Sorry, but would you mind teaching me the proper methods?

records.jp: 任せて！　まずはね――
records.en_original: Leave it to me! First...
records.en_auxiliary: Leave it to me! First...
records.en: Leave it to me! First...

records.jp: （確かこれって、化粧の後は色んな所へ買い物に……<CR>でも、有理が挑戦する気になって良かった……かな？）
records.en_original: (I expect a trip to the store once her makeup's done. But I guess it's good that Yuri decided to challenge herself...)
records.en_auxiliary: (I expect a trip to the store once her makeup's done. But I guess it's good that Yuri decided to challenge herself to try something new.)
records.en: (I expect a trip to the store once her makeup's done. But I guess it's good that Yuri decided to challenge herself...)
